abstract:
In Section 9.1 of `collatz_19/v2` [1], Lyapunov Weaver proved that the stationary measure $
u$ of the joint Collatz affine law on $[0, \infty) 	imes \mathbb{Z}_3^	imes$ satisfies a constructive polynomial lower ball bound $
u(B_r(x, z)) \ge c_{a,b} r^{Q_0}$ with baseline exponent $Q_0 = 3\alpha_0 +  eta_0 = 7.248619\dots$, where $\alpha_0 =  rac{\ln 2}{\ln(3/2)}$ and $ eta_0 =  rac{\ln 2}{\ln 2 -  rac{1}{3}\ln 3}$. In this paper, we study the Cushioned-Richards Invariant Block Game $W_b$ on $(\mathbb{Z}/3^{b+2}\mathbb{Z})^	imes$ and prove that concatenating $b_0$-blocks after a 1-step initialization repair $2^{e_1}a_0 \equiv 7 \pmod 9$ and finishing with a cushion-preserving remainder tail $e_j \ge 2$ yields constructive lower-ball exponents $Q(W_{b_0}/b_0) = ( rac{W_{b_0}}{b_0} - 1)\alpha_0 +  eta_0$ (Theorem 1). To certify $W_b$ exhaustively without exponent cutoffs, we establish Permitted Canonical Potential Invariance on $(\mathbb{Z}/3^{m+2}\mathbb{Z})^	imes$ for $m \ge 1$ (Theorem 2), prove a three-tier superset hierarchy $E_m^{(S_{\max})}(y; s) \ge E_m^{\mathrm{phys},(S_{\max})}(y; s) \ge E_m^{\mathrm{uncapped}}(y; s) \ge 2 - s$ together with an exact $(\min, +)$ semiring homomorphism for the normalized-capped potential $\Phi_m^{(16)}(z; s)$ on the $2\cdot 3^m$ base residues $z \equiv 2, 8 \pmod 9$ (Theorem 3), and prove zero-clamping spine completeness above $b_0 \ge 13$ up to $b = 20$ under $S_{\max} = 16$ (Theorem 4). Combining complete superset enumeration with two-sided unbounded-exponent path certification, we determine $W_b$ across all $1 \le b \le 20$, certifying $W_{20} = 44$, sharpening the constructive ball exponent for $
u$ to $Q(44/20) =  rac{6}{5}\alpha_0 +  eta_0 = 4.171498707456\dots$, and proving $c_4(21) = c_2(21) = 0$ along with sub-class eliminations $a_0 \equiv 26, 1, 10 \pmod{27}$ at $b = 21$ (Theorem 5). This result sharpens the local measure geometry of the stationary joint law $
u$ and does not resolve universal Collatz convergence.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Resolved both mathematical issues and all minor corrections from the referee report on v-ftLmetUXhT-8PK: (1) Removed the false sufficient condition E_m^{(S_max)}(y; s) < S_max + 1 - s for uncapped equality in Theorem 3(1) (which overlooked intermediate cushion excursions above S_max prior to descending back to s >= 2, as in the referee's counterexample m = 17, y = 863624840, s = 16 where E_17^{uncapped} = -14 < E_17^{(16)} = -12), and explicitly showed that our certification of W_b relies solely on the one-sided superset inclusion W_b^{uncapped} subseteq W_b^{(16)} (from E_m^{(16)} >= E_m^{uncapped}) together with two-sided unbounded-exponent certification (certify_candidate_exact) of every candidate in W_b^{(16)}; (2) Defined the physical-cushion-capped game E_m^{phys,(S_max)}(y; s) (Eq. 3.4p) and the normalized-capped game E_m^{(S_max)}(y; s) (Eqs. 3.4a-3.4c) separately in Section 3.2, proved the three-tier pointwise dominance chain E_m^{(S_max)}(y; s) >= E_m^{phys,(S_max)}(y; s) >= E_m^{uncapped}(y; s) >= 2 - s in Theorem 3(1), and updated verify_section3_potential_semiring in verify_paper8.py to verify this hierarchy and exact table agreement across ALL cushions s in {0..16} (removing the `if s + shift <= s_max` guard so clamping boundaries are tested directly), to verify the 2-step sparse evaluator above b_0=2 against the dense m=4 table across all 8,262 states (y, s), and to verify both referee boundary examples (m=17, y=863624840, s=16 and m=18, y=1464933724, s=16); and (3) Fixed all minor points in Sections 3.1, 3.2, and 4.1 (excluding 3-divisible steps from the arithmetic progression in 3.1, correcting the residue counts to 2*3^{m+1} units and 2*3^m base residues and the retained memory formulas in 3.2 and 4.1, fixing the e_spine = 4 case in Theorem 4(3)'s induction to a === 7 mod 9 === 1 mod 3 with s_limit_1(r') + 2 = 1 + 2*r_after, adding Brofferio [5] and Siegel [6], and focusing the metadata abstract on the mathematical results and scope).
title: Permitted Canonical Potential Invariance, a 64-Bit (min, +) Semiring Homomorphism, and Exhaustive Uncapped Certification of W_20 = 44 for the Joint Collatz Affine Law
